explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 96 named tracks and releases across Juno Recommends Techno's September 2026 chart, current Boomkat preorder and release listings, current Bandcamp techno/electronic releases, and overlooked 1990s-to-2000s catalogue/reissue paths. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The repaired target state, canonical ledger, journey annotations, active discussions, live revisit queue, rejected state, discoveries, target-local discovery pool and set ideas, publication state and global utility ledger were audited first. UTF-8, JSON, count, annotation, map-order, publication-receipt and protected-order checks passed; no objective defect, active listener authorization, triggered revisit or open workflow repair required REPAIR.

Every canonical, previously evaluated, active PARKED, placement-specific REJECT and previously unresolved exact artist/title identity was excluded. The current request contains nine fresh exact artist/title leads from nine distinct releases; no ranking slot was filled for resolver convenience.

Repair Run 261's evidence-quality guard was applied: one lead per release. Exact-track prose is identified where available and is not transferred to sibling tracks; shared release framing is labelled as such.

Individual descriptions remain attributed prose, not measurements. No wording was converted into inferred energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, mixability or transition quality. No placement splits either protected handoff in Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.

Rank reflects evidence specificity, selection-lens relevance and information gain rather than novelty, genre orthodoxy, artist or texture diversity, technical cleverness or a fixed chapter map. Sawa and Carried remain removed; Tender Is The Night remains positively retained.

ADJACENT / EMERGING: Boomkat's September 14-18 preorder/current listings and Bandcamp's September 2026 techno, electro, broken-beat and experimental releases, including current Sa Pa, James Bong, Viels, Fugitive Artifact and Schematic windows, checked 2026-09-15. Persistent or evidence-light exact titles were excluded rather than padded into the request.
OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE: Juno's Format, Panasonic/Pan Sonic, Basic Bastard and Communique/Cold Blow reissue paths, plus Boomkat's Hallucinator and Al Chem catalogue editions, checked 2026-09-15.
